what_happened: Root-cause and fix design located cleanly within one script (lean-plan-compliance-check.sh) with zero change needed to the calling agent file's step 5 code block, step 0, or steps 1-4 -- the script already receives the plan file path it needs to derive both widening sources (Files-to-modify harvest via an existing core-extension script, and the Challenge manifest). Reused plan-file-scope-harvest.sh rather than designing a new plan parser.

Concurrent sibling task #504 (also 'researching' this cycle) declares file_scope on the exact same two files this task's recommendation touches (lean-plan-compliance-check.sh and its test suite), for an unrelated defect (over-broad Goals-prose backtick harvest, narrowing WHICH names are harvested) vs. this task's concern (WHERE a harvested name is searched). Changes land in different regions of the same files and should not textually conflict, but flagged in the report's Risks section for re-read-before-edit discipline at implement time.

Plan-phase synthetic reproduction confirmed the defect live before any implementation: a Goal declared only in a plan-named specs/evidence probe file yields [MISSING]/failed/exit 1, while plan-file-scope-harvest.sh on the same plan returns exactly that probe path. The whole fix mechanism (harvester output -> widened grep scope) was validated end-to-end at authoring time, and the existing suite baseline was measured clean at 19/19, so Phase 1's criterion is a satisfiable absolute rather than a guessed delta.

Out-of-scope adjacent blind spot recorded as a follow-up candidate: lean-implementation-agent.md's step 6 comparator-gate Preflight 4 resolves comparator_solution_module via its own inline grep over the same roots-only scope, so widening find_decl_files does NOT fix it. A probe-pinned plan that also opts into --compare will still hit comparator_solution_module_unresolved after this task lands. Deliberately not folded in: the dispatch names exactly one additional sub-check to widen (the replacement-target sweep).

Plan's D7 harvester-resolution ladder, read literally as a 4-rung cascade including the env override, would make the plan's own Phase 1 Verification bullet 3 (LEAN_PLAN_COMPLIANCE_HARVESTER pointed at a nonexistent path -> fail-soft) untestable in this repo: the source-store sibling rung always resolves when running from the source store, so the override would silently have no effect. Implemented an explicitly-set override as terminal (used if readable, else treated as unresolved outright, never falling through to the remaining rungs), matching lean-comparator-run.sh's own env-override-with-sibling-default precedent and satisfying the plan's own verification bullet.

Plan-time suite baseline of 19 passed/0 failed had drifted to 22 passed/0 failed by implement-time: sibling task #504 (concurrent territory overlap already flagged in the plan's Risk table) committed cases C21 and C22 to test-lean-plan-compliance-check.sh after this plan was written. Re-derived the live baseline at Phase 1's pre-write re-read and verified the same 22/22 unchanged after this phase's edits, rather than checking against the stale plan-time count of 19.

Phase 2's plan-time case numbering (C20-C25) collided with sibling task #504's already-landed C21/C22 by implement time. Renumbered this phase's six new cases upward to C23-C28 (appended strictly after the live tail's C22), per the plan's own Scope Hypothesis instruction to renumber rather than reuse a number when a sibling already occupies it.

Follow-up candidate, deliberately out of scope for this task: lean-implementation-agent.md's Final Verification Stage step 6 (comparator-gate Preflight 4, 'derive solution_module') greps only "${lean_roots[@]}" to resolve a manifest theorem_name's declaring file, inline, independently of lean-plan-compliance-check.sh's own find_decl_files. It carries the structurally identical blind spot this task fixed in the spot-check: a plan whose Goals are pinned in an evidence-probe location outside the resolved source roots and that also opts into --compare would still hit comparator_solution_module_unresolved. Not fixed here because the dispatch names exactly one additional sub-check to widen (the replacement-target sweep, already covered) and this is a separate, inline grep in a different step.
